label: Intraday
description: 1h bars, flat by end of session. No overnight exposure.

howToEvaluate: Favor setups that can prove themselves quickly inside the same session.

avoid: Do not rely on slow multi-day thesis development for an intraday-flat session.

label: Swing
description: 4h bars, multi-day hold. Closes within 2 weeks.

howToEvaluate: Prefer structures that can persist across several days rather than only intraday noise.

label: Position
description: Daily bars, weeks-long hold. Fundamentals carry weight.

howToEvaluate: Give more weight to durable business and catalyst context because the hold window is longer.
Reject setups that only make sense as short-lived tactical trades.

label: Prediction
description: Daily bars, hold to event resolution. No fixed time target.
summaryBullets: Exit at resolution or thesis invalidation.

howToEvaluate: Anchor the decision to event resolution and thesis validity rather than standard chart-based hold logic.

values.timeframeNotes: Hold to event resolution unless thesis is invalidated early.

label: Custom Timeframe
description: No preset assumptions — set timeframe fields manually.

howToEvaluate: Use the explicit timeframe fields and notes as the authority because there is no preset horizon assumption.
